blockers.title: Separate decisions from completed operations
blockers.required_change: Separate eligibility/proposal, attempted request, observed bytes, committed retention, archive readback, analytical inclusion and publication. Completed retention requires legitimate access plus complete scoped bytes/hash/time and confirmed destination commit/readback. Reconcile operations and observations independently; archive readback may observe bytes without a new source download. Preserve fixed historical research envelopes.
blockers.completion_evidence: Every listed mutation rejected; positive fixtures admit only correctly scoped complete records; no automatic promotion from an action enum.

blockers.title: Bind rights to object, edition and use
blockers.required_change: Require a structured applicable grant/basis with nonempty resolving evidence, exact object/edition binding where claimed, and permitted use. Private research storage can have a non-open-license basis; public eligibility must have an actual applicable redistribution grant. Publication authorization remains independent and false here.
blockers.completion_evidence: Reject missing grant/evidence/version and unsupported public eligibility while preserving valid research-private positive cases and timestamp+hash mutable snapshots.

blockers.title: Enforce content-state and coverage transitions
blockers.required_change: Blocked/unrequested objects cannot claim local byte verification or complete native coverage. Partial measurements use partial-only scope. Historical measurements remain historically reported; later readback is a distinct observation. Bind format, representation and state consistently. Native coverage requires inventory comparison beyond byte integrity.
blockers.completion_evidence: Reject all state contradictions and accept explicit separately recorded historical/readback observations without rewriting history.

blockers.title: Require semantic identity and reference checks
blockers.required_change: Require unique keyed IDs, closed evidence/artifact/blocker/case refs, derived counts, canonical study edges, exact URL/version checks and evidence chronology. Schema documents that its semantic layer is necessary; never treat a schema-only pass as that layer.
blockers.completion_evidence: All 155 existing checked references stay closed, duplicate/dangling/count mutations fail, and metadata/editions/representations do not inflate independent-study coverage.

blockers.title: Make format validation and acquisition fixtures real
blockers.required_change: Pin working format dependencies or explicit tested checkers, including negative URI/date/date-time controls. Convert the eight prose cases into a separate executable harness with shared legitimate-access/rights/transfer/readback preconditions. Keep proposed versus actually executed results distinct.
blockers.completion_evidence: Prove format controls run; record separate executed positive/negative invariant tests. ACQ execution count changes only for actual authorized acquisition-harness execution, never for static review.
